title: Invoice cancellation restores stock
intent: Cancel an invoice and restore any inventory reserved for that invoice.
critic_improved_spec: Mark open invoices as cancelled and reject already paid invoices.
full_oracle_spec: Mark open invoices as cancelled and restore reserved inventory quantities for cancelled invoice lines.
missing_requirements: Reserved inventory must be restored when invoice is cancelled
Invoice status must update to cancelled
expected_naive_failure: The public spec omits a heldout policy invariant that changes implementation selection.
expected_defense: The oracle spec includes the heldout policy invariant.
